description: This file defines interfaces, enums, and structures for a WebTransport client over QUIC in the Chromium project, including state management, event callbacks, and client creation functions.
external_methods: CreateWebTransportClient(const GURL&, const url::Origin&, WebTransportClientVisitor*, const NetworkAnonymizationKey&, URLRequestContext*, const WebTransportParameters&)

classes.name: WebTransportCloseInfo
classes.description: Represents information about the closure of a WebTransport connection, including code and reason.

classes.name: WebTransportClientVisitor
classes.description: Interface for receiving events and state changes from a WebTransport client.

classes.name: WebTransportParameters
classes.description: Holds parameters for establishing a WebTransport session, such as security fingerprints and HTTP/3 enablement.

classes.name: WebTransportClient
classes.description: Abstract base class for a WebTransport client, providing methods to connect, close, and access the session.

methods.name: WebTransportCloseInfo(uint32_t, base::StringPiece)
methods.description: Constructor initializing close info with code and reason.

methods.name: Connect()
methods.description: Asynchronously initiates connection; calls visitor on completion.

methods.name: Close(const absl::optional<WebTransportCloseInfo>&)
methods.description: Initiates client-initiated termination of the session.

methods.name: session()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the WebTransport session, or nullptr if not connected.
